title: Registered-session bounded attribute-list analogue
purpose: Reach the valid-session unconnected explicit-message path and the Identity attribute-list response assembly with a small bounded request.
expected_behavior: After the harness substitutes the session handle returned by RegisterSession, the server parses the SendRRData CPF and CIP request and returns a normal response or ordinary CIP/encapsulation error. The bounded request should not require the historical corruption condition.
constraints_preserved: RegisterSession payload is protocol version 1 with zero options
CPF contains a Null Address Item followed by one Unconnected Data Item
The unconnected data item length is 10 bytes and matches the encoded CIP request
The GetAttributeList request targets Identity class 1, instance 1, with count 1 and attribute ID 1
The second frame uses a runtime-substituted negotiated session handle
issue_safety_notes: Preserves the affected valid-session SendRRData and GetAttributeList structural path while replacing the historical count of 80 with count 1 and omitting the optional sockaddr item combination. No exact historical payload is copied.
